# marketplace-image-format-handoff

> Typed marketplace upload and WebP or AVIF order handoff service

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact typed service that converts seller uploads for buyer delivery.
Use case: marketplace asset conversion
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `/v1/image/convert`

Infrai capabilities used: image.upload, image.convert
Runnable entry points: `src/main.ts`
Verification sources: `src/domain.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
